title: Vapouriz 50/50 Cool Menthol 10ml
description: Cool Menthol from the Vapouriz 50/50 collection is as breezy and refreshing as menthol flavours come. Freshly picked mint leaves lend a delicate sweetness to the crisp, pure sensation of invigorating menthol, with an endlessly smooth and satisfying throat hit. Vapouriz E-Liquids are expertly-crafted by Vapouriz Labs UK to deliver intense flavour and stunning vapour production for your e-cigarette setup. Browse the full Vapouriz 50/50 E-Liquid collection and pick up the perfect pairing for any Vape Kit , Starter Vape Kits or Compact Pod Vape Kit . We’ve got a selection of formulations to suit all styles of e-cigarette devices, including High-PG blends for classic vaping as well as Vapouriz Nicotine Salts and adaptable 50:50 Vape Juice options. What Is 50/50 E Liquid? 50/50 e-liquid is called so because it contains a 50% Vegetable Glycerine, 50% Propylene Glycol ratio, which allows for an extremely versatile vaping experience. These liquids can be used in Starter Vape Kits, High powered Sub Ohm Kits and Pod Vape Kits. For more information, Check out the full 50/50 vape juice guide
